title: Radio: Wren 16 Asks to Break Off for Pine Landing Tip

lines.text: Wren 16 to command. Tip line has a caller at the Pine Landing grocery store. She says there's a little girl in a purple jacket crying in a gray pickup in the lot, toolbox in the back. I'm about twelve minutes out. Do I break off the north gate road canvass and go?
Wren 16, Wren County, copy. Hold your position on the north gate road until command answers.
Command, Wren County. Update from the tip line on that Pine Landing caller. She's now saying the pickup has Washington plates, and it's pulling a horse trailer. Caller is still in the lot.

Command, Wren County. Second tip line caller, same grocery store lot. Says the girl in the gray pickup is with her dad, and he's loading groceries. Both callers' numbers are on the tip forms. How do you want this handled?
Wren 16, still on the north gate road. Standing by for your decision.

fields.voiceStyle: Male deputy in his thirties, steady but keyed up, talking over road noise; the dispatcher is a calm, clipped female voice

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The Washington plates and horse trailer don't match the description investigators stand behind (possible Oregon plate, no trailer, toolbox, no canopy), and the second caller gives an innocent explanation. Watch whether the IC and INV keep Wren 16 on the north gate road, ask a unit near Pine Landing (APD, OSP or a Deschutes mutual-aid deputy from staging) to do a welfare check, and log the result as a prioritized tip on CAD 26-081377.
